# Focus

![Focus](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/focus.png)

Builds its own Heads chance.

- **Rarity:** Uncommon
- **Heads chance:** 50%
- **Shop price:** 10 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Gain 15% Heads this level

## Tails
Score 4 points

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade)
